about: Evaluation set for AGENT_INTENT_LLM_ENABLED. 'handled' questions must be recognised by the deterministic parser (GoalIntent keywords or a UsefulQuestionIntent pattern); 'unhandled' must not be. scripts/evaluate_intent.py verifies each bucket before using it. 'expected' is a human judgement of the evidence classes a good answer needs; an empty list means no stored evidence class answers the question.
